name: Carla Benedict
original_name: カーラ・ベネディクト
source:
Lt. Colonel Carla Benedict is a former millitary commando and a commander of the moon base. Having both technical and commando background, she's perfectly suited to be in charge of all base operations. She keeps her military background secret, [spoiler]as well as her former marriage and subsequent divorce[/spoiler]. Her vast knowledge and power as well as her position also makes her a suspect in possible sabotage of base's operations so [url=https://vndb.org/c14801]Captain Leiji[/url] has to keep his true identity secret even from her.

[Edited from [url=http://engbishoujo.tripod.com/criticalprofiles.html]Game's Manual[/url] and [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/562753-critical-point/faqs/19503]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
